newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Unirab becomes private holding.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Unirab becomes private holding.

text.p: Egypt's United Arab Spinning and Weaving/Unirab has changed its status to private holding after the state sold off most of its stake in the firm, Unirab's board said in an annoucement published on Tuesday.
The announcement said it was the first state-owned textile firm to go into private hands.
In January, the state offered investors at least 10 percent, or 570,400 shares, of the firm and then sold 11.8 percent to private investors and an additional 6.1 percent to the firm's workers.
The holding company now owns a minority 33.4 percent, the firm's workers hold 16.1 percent and private investors hold the majority 50.5 percent.
The firm had also elected a new board, the announcement added.
